newsitem.title: GHANA: Ghana bourse closes sharply lower.
newsitem.headline: Ghana bourse closes sharply lower.

text.p: Ghanaian stocks came off sharply on Monday with Mobil Oil Ghana Ltd among notable decliners.
The All-Share Index fell 2.31 points to 366.97 on 621,410 shares traded. Offers totalled just over one million shares.
Mobil Oil fell 100 cedis to 5,900 while Ghana Commercial Bank Ltd declined 17 cedis to 701.
Ashanti Goldfields Co, which closed last week higher on the back of a rally in world gold prices, ended unchanged.
